name: iZ3D
summary: Early stereoscopic middleware wrapper contemporary with TriDef. Unlike TriDef, iZ3D released its source code before closing, making community revival possible. Still functional on Windows 7 with the final release. Supported DX9 and DX10 games, and was the primary middleware for AMD HD3D setups.
compatibility_notes: Company defunct since 2013 but source code is open. Last release works on Windows 7. Incompatible with Windows 10+ in standard configuration. Community forks exist exploring modern compatibility. DX11, DX12, and Vulkan not supported. Potentially revivable given open source status.
